title: Platforms & lifecycle
description: The multi-surface deployment matrix and per-platform model lifecycle for the Claude estate — compliance posture by surface and divergent retirement deadlines. Reference served by the engine, never recomputed.
liveReference: Reference served by the engine — AsOf {{date}}, source {{source}}.
unavailable: The platforms reference is unavailable on this engine

surfaces.title: Deployment surfaces
surfaces.description: The six modeled Claude surfaces (ANT2-01/17). Each differs in base URL, auth, model-id form, billing, residency and compliance posture — they are not interchangeable.
surfaces.matrixSummary: Six deployment surfaces compared across operator, endpoint, auth, model-id form, API support, billing, HIPAA, ZDR and residency.
surfaces.unmodeledHint: This gateway is not one of the six modeled Claude surfaces; its compliance and residency attributes are not declared and are not inferred.
surfaces.apiSupportDescription: Which Anthropic API families apply per surface. A surface without the Admin/Models/Compliance APIs cannot serve Anthropic-side governance ingest — it degrades honestly, never reports empty as "no findings".

compliance.title: Compliance posture
compliance.description: HIPAA / FedRAMP / IL / ZDR are a per-surface axis (where inference runs), distinct from a model's or provider's GPAI posture. Do not conflate them.
compliance.hipaaNote: HIPAA is shown with its confirm status. A "to-confirm" posture is never rendered as a hard yes or no.

lifecycle.title: Per-platform model lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Model retirement is per-platform, not global (ANT2-03). Anthropic-operated surfaces retire a model on a different date than Bedrock and Vertex — a single "retired" flag would give a false migration deadline on half the estate.
lifecycle.noSuccessorHint: The authority named no replacement model for this family. None is inferred.

paramDeprecation.title: Parameter deprecation pre-advice
paramDeprecation.body: {{affected}} reject a non-default {{params}} with an HTTP {{status}}. This is Anthropic's deprecation (ANT2-03), not a product bug and not a fixable error — the inference plane withholds these parameters as pre-advice.

notes.title: Bedrock id & residency notes
notes.declaredNote: Web-declared reference: these notes cite modules/models/bedrock.go honesty facts the platforms endpoint does not serve. Each carries its own confirm status.
notes.crisIdFormat: Cross-region inference-profile id format is "<geo>.anthropic.<model>", geo ∈ {us, eu, apac, global}. The current Bedrock Mantle surface uses the bare "anthropic.<model>" id.
notes.crisOpusId: The concrete Bedrock Global-CRIS opus inference-profile id is not verified against the AWS page — the format is confirmed, that specific id is not presented as authoritative.
notes.globalRegionalPremium: AWS docs indicate regional inference profiles carry a ~10% premium over global (global is the cheaper baseline) — opposite of a "global +10%" assumption; the exact multiplier is unverified, so no premium is modeled.
notes.usBurndown: US-only inference burndown is 1.1× (Opus 4.6 / Sonnet 4.6+, inference_geo="us").

lifecycle.description: The engine's compiled Claude lifecycle reference must supply these deadlines; tenant activity and console input do not populate them.
